interpretation: Retrospective source-record recovery on purposive panels; decoys are unlabelled, not known ineffective. Not prospective or clinical validation.

manual_citation_audit.interpretation: Qualitative source-entailment judgments and scope qualifications, not a scientifically validated correctness rate. No ballot or metric was changed.

answers.pathways_help_jury: The jury had lower observed MRR with pathway evidence in these three pairs. Only 2/3 pairs had all six valid ballots; availability differences also affect this comparison. A reliable benefit is not established by three pairs.

limitations: No method passes the predeclared twelve-test Holm correction; this does not demonstrate equivalence to chance.
Only two of the three paired jury panels have all six valid ballots. Pathway benefit across eleven Diseases is unverified.
Eight invalid attempts include citation-ownership errors, lexical cytokine-name rejection and two Opus refusals on epilepsy; invalid outcomes are not a pure scientific-reasoning assessment.
Retrospective source-record recovery with unlabelled decoys, Target/mechanism fingerprints, purposive and related Diseases, and unadjudicated clinical label truth.
No independent human/domain-expert scientific audit or credit-cost verification was performed.
